title: SmartSpend AI
subtitle: Your AI Financial Assistant
content: An intelligent AI platform that helps users manage money, reduce overspending, and build smarter financial habits.

title: The Problem
content: Millions of people struggle with budgeting, overspending, and saving money because financial management is often confusing and stressful.

title: The Solution
content: SmartSpend AI analyzes monthly income and spending habits to automatically generate personalized financial plans and smart recommendations.

title: How It Works
content: Users enter their monthly income, expenses, savings goals, and lifestyle preferences. The AI instantly creates a smart financial strategy.

title: Core AI Features
content:
• AI Budget Planner
• Personalized AI Chat
• Expense Tracking
• Saving Predictions
• Real-Time Overspending Alerts

title: SmartSpend AI Pro
content: Premium subscriptions unlock advanced forecasting, investment guidance, unlimited AI chat, detailed analytics, and monthly financial reports.

title: Target Market
content: University students, young professionals, and families looking for a smarter and easier way to manage finances.

title: Business Model
content: Freemium business model with SmartSpend AI Pro subscriptions priced at $9.99/month plus future financial partnerships.
